ValidationRule.description: Ensures Date Sent to AM field is populated when the account manager is populated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( $RecordType.Name = 'CLAS - Shred', $RecordType.Name = 'CLAS – Data Management', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Retention_RM'), NOT(ISBLANK(Account_Manager__c)), ISBLANK(Date_Sent_to_AM__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Sent to AM needs to be populated for Account Manager field
